title: Global Stock Rally Extends, Oil Advances on Iran: Markets Wrap
summary: Global stocks traded near a record high as Asian shares tracked Wall Street higher after soft US jobs data eased expectations for a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike. Oil extended gains as Iran rejected talks with the US and a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz remained elusive.

title: Iran Shakes Up Security Team Claiming Oman Deal ‘Close’
summary: Iran promoted a hard-line ex-commander as its top security official, shaking up its highest decision-making body on national defense after saying it was “very close” to a deal with Oman over shipping through the Strait of Hormuz. Bloomberg's Stuart Livingstone-Wallace shares what we know about the situation. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: China’s Slower-Than-Expected Price Gains Revive Deflation Risk
summary: China’s consumer prices grew at the slowest pace in six months while factory-gate inflation eased for the first time since the Iran war broke out in late February, in another sign that reflation momentum is fading as the oil shock subsides and domestic spending languishes.

title: Netanyahu Rejects US-Backed Hamas Disarmament Proposal
summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has rejected a proposal by US-backed mediators for disarming Hamas, saying "Israel does not accept the 15-point document". Bloomberg's Dan Williams breaks down the developments. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Copper Holds $14,000 as Weaker US Rate Outlook Boosts Metals
summary: Copper traded in a narrow range after six straight weeks of gains, fueled by tightening supplies and easing concerns about US interest-rate hikes.

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Aug. 10
summary: Oil extended gains as Iran and Oman remained short of a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, while Houthi militants claimed an attack on a Saudi refinery near the Red Sea.

title: NYSE President on Asia Business, IPO Pipeline
summary: Lynn Martin, President at the NYSE Group, discuses the exchange's business strategy and priorities in Asia, as well as the IPO pipeline in the US. She speaks with Paul Allen on Insight with Haslinda Amin.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Emerging-Market Stocks, Currencies Gain After Soft US Jobs Data
summary: Emerging-market stocks and currencies climbed at the start of a new week as expectations for Federal Reserve rate hikes eased following Friday’s unexpectedly weak US employment report.

title: Jobs Data Won't Move Fed's Thinking: Natixis' Hodge
summary: Christopher Hodge, Natixis Chief US Economist, expects a modest uptick in unemployment in the upcoming US jobs report. He joins Bloomberg's Vonnie Quinn on "Bloomberg Brief." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Indonesian Stocks Near Bull Market as Economic Worries Recede
summary: Indonesian stocks advanced, putting the benchmark index once again near bull-market territory, as investor sentiment was buoyed by signs of a resilient economy and easing concerns over potential market downgrades.

title: Rotation From Leveraged ETFs Fuels 30% Jump in Korea Small Caps
summary: South Korea’s small-cap stocks are regaining investor interest after lagging larger peers for much of the year, as restrictions on leveraged exchanged-traded funds tracking heavyweight chipmakers shift money toward Kosdaq names.

title: Yen Underperforms G-10 Peers as Intervention Boost Fades
summary: The yen has underperformed all its Group-of-10 peers this month as the boost from recent intervention fades, putting traders on alert for further official action.

title: Wheat Hits Highest in a Week on Supply Disruptions in Black Sea
summary: US wheat futures jumped to the highest in more than a week, as disruptions to shipping in the Black Sea raised the prospect of supply shortages from the crucial grain-growing region.

title: Gold Holds Above $4,300 as Soft Jobs Data Trims Rate-Hike Bets
summary: Gold steadied above $4,300 an ounce, with investors assessing a surprise contraction in the US jobs market that allayed concerns around an interest-rate hike.

title: India’s FX Reserves Climb Toward Record on Foreign Inflows
summary: Stockpile rises for five straight weeks, the longest run since April 2025.

title: Shein Valued at $22 Billion to $25 Billion Ahead of IPO, BI Says
summary: Shein Global Holdings Ltd.’s fast-fashion niche supports a valuation of $22 billion to $25 billion, Bloomberg Intelligence said, putting a fresh marker on one of the biggest questions surrounding the retailer as it prepares for one of the year’s biggest initial public offerings.

title: Australia Widens Orders on Chinese Investors in Rare Earths Firm
summary: Australia has stepped in again to try to force some Chinese investors out of a rare earths mining firm, telling two parties that they will also need government approval before selling their holdings to ensure the shares aren’t sold to any related parties.

title: Australian Scandium Miner Soars After $400 Million US Investment
summary: Sunrise Energy Metals Ltd. shares soared after the Australian scandium miner secured as much as $400 million in long-term debt financing from the US Department of War.
